call_purpose: New leads from your funnel form had stopped reaching your CRM about three days ago.

resolved.text: Following our guidance, you corrected the webhook URL and saved it, and you confirmed a test lead now shows up in your CRM, so new leads are reaching it again.

covered.text: We found that the webhook URL in your webhook settings contained a typo in its address. This is only partly resolved: the leads from the last three days that did not reach your CRM are still to be resent.

support_next_steps.text: We will have the leads from the last three days that did not reach your CRM resent to it, and we will message you once that is done.
